title: Litigation Legal Counsel
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Litigation Legal Counsel, you’ll work on litigation and pre-litigation matters of the Vinted group and you will be part of the legal function.

In this position, you’ll 

• Manage litigation and pre-litigation matters touching upon regulatory, consumer affairs, platform regulations, content-related matters, privacy and commercial/contractual disputes

• Handle and streamline processes related to Request for Information received from various authorities

• Advise management stakeholders on litigation strategy and risks

• Develop creative approaches to managing legal risks and resolving disputes

• Work with and coordinate outsourced legal counsels in all the jurisdictions in which we operate

• Work closely with business teams (such as Product, PR, Customer Support, and other teams to identify and address relevant legal risks)

• Build processes (e.g. training, guidelines, etc.) with other legal peers in order to support legal compliance across the company

About you 

• An experienced mid-level lawyer with a litigation background in a law firm and/or as an in-house counsel (commercial, platform and consumer-related ideally) 

• Qualification in one bar association is a plus

• Experience managing multiple high priority projects simultaneously

• Experience managing high stakes, complex litigation

• Experience dealing with authorities (request for information, regulatory litigation, etc)

• Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English

• Platform-related litigation experience is a strong plus

• Experience managing collective actions and/or European Court of Justice proceedings is a strong plus

• The skills, willingness, and initiative to own legal issues across many different jurisdictions

• Proactivity and attention to detail

• Passionate about technology-driven businesses

Work perks 

• The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

• 25 working days of holiday

• Newest MacBook models

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

• Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card

• Comprehensive Medical Coverage

• Frequent team-building events

• A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

• A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 d

title: Product Platform: Backend Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

AI is being built by many companies at once. Model labs train more capable models, hyperscalers provide infrastructure and distribution, developers build new AI products, and a growing set of tools gives agents more to work with. Baseten sits at the center of all of it, as the inference platform that developers and large companies use to run AI in production.

We’re hiring a backend/distributed systems engineer to join our Product Platform in following areas:

- Commercialization, billing, and partnerships

- Developer productivity and agentic development

- Observability platform

Please come join our growing team to work on exciting problems. A few sample projects and responsibilities will include

- Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, and traces across Baseten’s multi-cloud infrastructure

- Own and evolve core observability platforms, driving migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth

- Build world class commercialization and billing systems

- Work on some of the most strategic and exciting partnership integrations

- Develop internal infrastructure and tooling that improves developer velocity, CI/CD, and deployment safety.

- Own the internal AI agent platform end to end - architecture, build, rollout, operation, measurement.

- Own Baseten's testing strategy end to end - define the standards, the tiers, and the tooling that engineering teams build against.

- Drive adoption through developer experience - good defaults, clear docs, low friction - not mandate.

- Improve platform reliability through better alerting, incident tooling, and production debugging workflows.

- Lead technical design for cross-team projects and make sound tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

- Partner with infrastructure, model performance, and product teams to understand what they need to see and ship faster.

- Raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and clear technical writing.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a focus on building scalable backend systems and platforms.

- Experience building or operating observability systems (logging, metrics, tracing) or internal infrastructure at scale.

- Proficiency in Python, Go, Rust, or a similar backend language.

- A firm grasp of quality and engineering principles: you understand both the what and the why.

- Strong systems-level thinking: you understand how the components of a distributed system interact and how data flows through each part.

- Platform mindset: you build for adoption and self-service, treat internal engineers as customers, and would rather ship a good default than write a style guide.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

- (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

- Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

- Paid parental leave

- Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

- (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

- Exposure to a variety of ML start

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Porto, Portugal

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

title: Data Quality / Governance Analyst
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Data Quality / Governance Analyst to support Task 3 data governance, accuracy, and cross-system alignment for a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment.
This role validates data sources, maintains metadata rules and data dictionaries, supports tagging standards, and performs continuous quality checks to ensure accurate reporting, dashboards, and analytics.
The Data Quality / Governance Analyst collaborates closely with Task 2 and Task 3 reporting teams, dashboard developers, data owners, and PMO leadership to maintain consistent, reliable, and governable enterprise data.
This position is fully remote.
Duties & Responsibilities

• Validate Task 3 data sources and assess accuracy, completeness, and reliability.

• Maintain data dictionaries, metadata rules, tagging standards, and classification definitions.

• Ensure consistency of KPIs, metrics, and datasets across Tasks 2 and 3.

• Perform data reconciliation, profiling, cleansing, and quality checks.

• Support cross-task data harmonization and integration workflows.

• Identify data anomalies, gaps, or inconsistencies and recommend remediation steps.

• Collaborate with dashboard teams, analysts, and system owners to align data definitions.

• Maintain documentation for data governance processes, metadata rules, and data lineage.

• Track source system changes, schema updates, and data dependency impacts.

• Support adherence to federal data governance standards and reporting requirements.

• Contribute to the development and maintenance of dashboard specifications, metric definitions, and reporting standardization under Data COE-owned standards.

Qualifications

• Active Secret clearance required.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in data governance, data quality, metadata management, or a directly related data management discipline.

• Experience maintaining data dictionaries, metadata rules, and standardized data fields.

• Experience performing data validation, profiling, or cleansing.

• Demonstrated experience reconciling conflicting metrics across independent source systems, including diagnosing differences in definition, population/filter logic, refresh timing, and transformation logic.

• Experience supporting cross-team or cross-system data harmonization efforts.

Skills & Competencies

• Strong High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

• Analytical and problem-solving ability, particularly in diagnosing the root cause of data discrepancies.

• Clear written communication, including the ability to produce standards documentation, data dictionary entries, and remediation write-ups that non-technical stakeholders can act on.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

• Understanding of data governance frameworks, data quality principles, and metadata standards.

• Proficiency with Excel, SQL, or similar tools for data validation and analysis.

• Familiarity with KPI frameworks and structured metric definitions.

• Working knowledge of PII handling and Privacy Act requirements as applied to reporting, including aggregation practices and small-cell suppression thresholds for sensitive population data.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

• Experience with Power BI, including Power Query/M and DAX; Tableau, Grafana, or similar BI tools.

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms or ETL/ELT tools.

• Familiarity with data catalog or governance tooling.

• Familiarity with the DoD Data Strategy (VAULTIS).

Certifications (preferred)

• ITIL v4 Foundation

• Data governance or data management certifications

OpenAI’s Legal team plays a crucial role in advancing our mission by tackling innovative and fundamental legal issues in AI. The team includes professionals with expertise spanning technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. If you’re passionate about meaningful and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you.

About the Role

We are seeking an employment lawyer to help build the legal foundations for OpenAI’s next stage of growth. Working closely with our employment counsel team and colleagues across the company, you will shape practical approaches to challenging employment issues in a fast-growing AI company. This is a hands-on role for a thoughtful lawyer who enjoys variety, moves quickly, and wants to help build a strong employment legal function as the business scales.

You will collaborate with experienced employment counsel on US and international employment issues, the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, and emerging questions about AI in the workplace. A central part of your work will be turning lessons from individual matters into practical policies, guidance, and approaches that work at scale. You will also own stakeholder relationships and manage counseling matters, exercising sound judgment and taking responsibility for outcomes. You will join a bright, collaborative team that values initiative and shared learning, with opportunities to learn from senior colleagues, deepen your expertise, and take on increasingly complex matters over time.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Help shape OpenAI’s employment legal approach as the company scales, developing practical policies, playbooks, and processes that address recurring issues and support sound, timely decisions.

- Collaborate with senior employment counsel and cross-functional partners on a broad range of US employment matters, including recruiting and hiring, performance management, employee conduct, leaves of absence, accommodations, and separations.

- Advise on international employment matters and support the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, including diligence and workforce integration, collaborating with local and specialist counsel as appropriate.

- Draft and negotiate employment documents and agreements, and identify practical ways to strengthen how the company handles employment matters as it grows.

- Have 7+ years of relevant employment law experience at a law firm, an in-house legal team, or a combination of both, with a record of excellent work and increasing responsibility.

- Have strong knowledge of US employment law, including California law, and sound judgment in advising on a broad range of workplace matters.

- Analyze unfamiliar issues quickly and translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical recommendations that account for business needs and employee experience.

- Enjoy building in a fast-growth environment: spotting gaps, developing practical solutions, and seeing them through to implementation.

description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DEVELOPMENT TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Find enough land to deploy multiple gigawatts a week. By 2030 we need to bring on multiple gigawatts of new capacity every week, which means securing sites at a pace and scale no one in the industry has operated at. You'll own finding and locking that land ahead of the build.

- Get power online in months, not years. Most of the clock runs before the lease is ever signed. You'll optimize the pre-signature work, site diligence, permitting, and development, so a site goes from signed lease to live power in under six months.

- Acquire 10s to 100s of GWs behind the meter. Reaching that scale means generating on-site instead of waiting on grid interconnection. You'll secure the land and behind-the-meter solar generation to get there.

ROLE SCOPE

Manage the team and scale the program responsible for sourcing multiple GWs of US powered land, powered shell, and turnkey opportunities through a network of brokers, landowners, and developers you build.

 

1. Run diligence on every candidate site: utility and behind-the-meter power at 4200MW+ scale, with security, availability, and ramp validated directly with utilities; buildability from title, surveys, geotechnical, and environmental reports; and permitting requirements mapped against our construction schedule.

2. Negotiate leases, PSAs, and JV structures with landowners, developers, data center operators, and private equity firms, and test each deal's financeability and multi-year cost with Finance and executive leadership.

3. Direct vendor due diligence, including on-site audits with specialist engineers, and work with the DC Design team so every site meets our current technical requirements for scale and design.

4. Own capacity planning and forecasting across all clients and regions so capacity is ready for new and unforeseen projects, and build and mentor the site selection team as it scales.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

Legora is scaling quickly, and our accounting team is growing with it. We’re hiring a Corporate Accounting Manager in New York to run our global close and manage a team of senior accountants across New York and Stockholm.

You’ll own the close end to end and make it faster and more reliable as we prepare for SOX and move to NetSuite. You’ll report to the Assistant Controller and work closely with Technical Accounting, FP&A, Tax, and our AP, AR, and Payroll teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own what the Corporate accounting team in New York and Stockholm delivers each month, from task assignment to final sign-off

- Prepare key reconciliations, accruals, and journal entries alongside the team during close when needed

- Partner with the AP, AR, and Payroll leads on cutoff, accruals, and the other inputs the close depends on

- Partner with Technical Accounting to book and support complex areas such as leases and capitalized software

- Help integrate acquired entities into our close, consolidation, and control environment

- Own our balance sheet reconciliation standards and design internal controls as we prepare for SOX

- Serve as the main point of contact for our external auditors and own the audit timeline

- Lead the accounting side of our move to NetSuite

- Partner with FP&A on monthly reporting and with Tax on key inputs for provisions, transfer pricing, and indirect tax

WHAT YOU BRING

- 6+ years of accounting experience, including time at a high-growth tech company

- Experience running a multi-entity close and consolidation under US GAAP

- A track record of shortening a close or rebuilding close processes at a growing company

- Strong US GAAP knowledge

- Experience managing accountants as direct reports

- Audit experience: you’ve been the main point of contact and kept the audit on schedule

- Detail-oriented: you keep the close on schedule and still check the work yourself

- Clear communicator, comfortable working across time zones with Finance and the rest of the business

NICE TO HAVE

- CPA or other accounting certification

- Big 4 audit experience

- IFRS or K3 experience

- Experience implementing SOX controls at a pre-IPO or public company

- NetSuite experience, ideally including an ERP migration

- Experience using AI tools in accounting workflows

description:
About APA
APA runs a community for the CEOs and executive teams of the leading nonprofits in the US (see members). APA’s work focuses on three interconnected issue areas that shape opportunity and mobility for the next generation: aligning K12 education and youth development, reimagining postsecondary to workforce pathways, and increasing civic and democratic engagement. Our community currently includes 190 member organizations and 975 executive leaders. These organizations serve 34M young people annually and control $2B in annual spending. The average member organization is spending 80-100 hours in Alliance programming each year. APA provides the infrastructure and stewardship necessary for our member organizations to increase their impact and grow their reach, to effectively navigate new dynamics that arise in the field, and to launch collective action initiatives that address field-wide challenges too complex for any single organization to take on alone.
The Opportunity
The Senior Director of Development is a member of America’s Promise Alliance’s External Affairs team responsible for the end-to-end management and growth of a portfolio of national philanthropic funders and prospects. Reporting to the Vice President of External Affairs, the Senior Director ensures that priority funding relationships and opportunities move forward with strong preparation, clear next steps, high-quality materials, disciplined follow-through, and consistent stewardship.

• Strong hands-on experience with Oracle E-Business Suite R12/R12.2 .

• Application Tier administration

• Database refreshes

• Data Pump

• Strong database performance tuning and troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with AWR, ASH, SQL tuning and database diagnostics .

• Experience with Oracle RAC, ASM and Data Guard .

• Strong Linux/Unix administration and Shell scripting .

• Experience supporting high-availability and production environments.

• Experience with Oracle EBS Financials modules such as GL, AP and AR is preferred.

title: Silicon Design Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Silicon Design Lead to drive architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of key IP and subsystems for our AI hardware platforms. You will translate functional, performance, and security requirements into efficient silicon designs, owning technical decisions from architectural definition through implementation and integration.

Part of this role will focus on hardware security implementation in close partnership with OpenAI’s Security team. While the Security team owns the overarching security architecture and requirements, you will translate those requirements into silicon microarchitecture and implementation, balancing security capabilities with performance, power, area, and design complexity. The other part of this role will focus on driving general silicon architecture/microarchitecture. 

In this role, you will:

- Own architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of silicon IP and subsystems, from requirements and design specifications through integration and validation.

- Define hardware interfaces, data flows, and microarchitectural tradeoffs to meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements.

- Partner closely with OpenAI’s Security team to translate security architecture, requirements, and threat models into implementable hardware capabilities.

- Design and integrate hardware security mechanisms, including encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, and data protection across silicon subsystems.

- Evaluate architectural and implementation tradeoffs to ensure security capabilities meet functional and performance requirements.

- Collaborate with silicon architects, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive subsystem design, integration, and validation.

- Review and contribute to RTL implementations, ensuring designs align with architectural intent and system requirements.

- Evaluate existing and third-party IP, identify architectural or implementation gaps, and drive solutions across subsystem boundaries.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have strong experience in silicon IP or subsystem-level architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation.

- Have owned hardware IP or subsystem designs from architectural definition through implementation and integration.

- Have experience implementing hardware security features such as memory encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, or secure boot.

- Understand how to translate functional and security requirements into hardware architectures, interfaces, and microarchitectural specifications.

- Have working knowledge of RTL design and coding proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog, with the ability to read, review, and contribute to RTL.

- Can evaluate performance, power, area, and complexity tradeoffs across silicon designs.

- Work effectively across security, silicon architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive designs from concept through execution.

- Ideally, have broader SoC-level architecture or integration experience, though deep IP or subsystem-level expertise is sufficient.

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

PRODUCT AT BASETEN

Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

THE ROLE

Build the future of AI model routing, where every task gets the right model, automatically.

Today, developers often have to choose between models that are faster, cheaper, or more capable. But the right model isn't always the same for every request.

Grid is Baseten's intelligent model routing platform, designed to help developers get the best possible results across open and frontier models without manually managing every decision.

We're starting with coding agents, where model choice can have an enormous impact on quality, speed, and cost.

As Product Manager for Grid, you'll work with engineers, researchers, and customers to build a new category of AI infrastructure. You'll help shape how intelligent routing works, how developers control it, and how we prove it's better than choosing a single model.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the product roadmap for Grid, from early developer adoption to production deployments and enterprise expansion.

- Work with researchers and engineers to improve intelligent model selection, routing policies, fallbacks, and controls.

- Build evaluation frameworks that measure real-world outcomes, including task quality, completion time, latency, and total cost.

- Shape the developer experience for onboarding, configuration, observability, and routing decisions.

- Help customers understand why a model was selected and give them confidence and control over how routing behaves.

- Work through technical challenges involving conversation history, tool compatibility, prompt caching, retries, and routing overhead.

- Partner with GTM and customers to turn early pilots into sustained adoption and revenue growth.

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience building and commercializing AI/ML products or developer platforms, with demonstrated adoption or business impact.

- A technical background in software engineering, ML engineering, research, or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Experience working with researchers or ML engineers on model behavior, evaluation, or learned systems in production.

- Strong understanding of AI model quality, latency, cost, and the tradeoffs involved in optimizing across them.

- Excellent developer product instincts, with an appreciation for both simple APIs and enterprise-level controls.

- Hands-on experience using coding agents and a strong point of view on where automation helps developers and where they need control.

- Comfort building emerging products where the technical approach and customer expectations are still evolving.

description:
Über uns:
Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.
Open Source ist unsere DNA: Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.
Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power: Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.
Dein Wirkungsbereich:
Als Teil unseres DC.Ops-Teams berichtest Du an den Lead Plattform Architekten und verantwortest das, was unsere Cloud im Kern ausmacht: die OpenStack-Plattform. Sie läuft auf unserer eigenen Hardware, in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren, mit Ceph als Storage-Backend - und sie entsteht gerade erst. Das heißt: keine gewachsene Landschaft, keine Altlasten, keine Entscheidungen, die vor Deiner Zeit getroffen wurden. Du prägst die Standards, mit denen wir jede weitere Region ausrollen.
Deine Rolle:

•
OpenStack verantworten: Du betreibst und entwickelst unsere Control Plane und Compute Nodes weiter - Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Placement und die Services, die wir als Nächstes dazunehmen. Du kennst nicht nur die Komponenten, sondern auch ihr Zusammenspiel.

•
Deployment & Lifecycle: Du rollst OpenStack reproduzierbar aus und hältst es aktuell - Deployment-Tooling wie Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack-Ansible oder OSISM, saubere Upgrade-Pfade über Releases hinweg, Rolling Upgrades ohne Ausfall für Kund:innen.

•
Neutron & Netzwerk: Neutron mit OVN bzw. Open vSwitch, Provider- und Tenant-Netze, Floating IPs, Security Groups, Load Balancing mit Octavia - Du verstehst, welchen Weg ein Paket durch die Virtualisierung tatsächlich nimmt.

•
Compute & Scheduling: KVM/libvirt als Fundament, Flavor- und Aggregate-Design, Scheduler- und Placement-Verhalten, Live Migration, Overcommit-Strategien, Quotas und Multi-Tenancy - inklusive GPU-Passthrough für unsere AI-Workloads.

•
Storage-Integration: Du sorgst dafür, dass Ceph und OpenStack sauber zusammenspielen - RBD für Nova und Cinder, Images über Glance, Object Storage über RGW - und arbeitest eng mit unserem Ceph Engineer zusammen.

•
Debugging auf tiefer Ebene: Hängende Nova-Instanzen, RabbitMQ unter Last, Galera-Cluster mit Eigenleben, Neutron-Agents, die nicht mehr melden - Du gehst bis auf Log- und Kernel-Ebene und findest die Ursache statt des Symptoms.

•
Automatisierung als Standard: Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitOps mit Flux, CI/CD - was zweimal passiert, passiert bei uns automatisiert. Eigene Tools in Python oder Bash gehören dazu.

•
You built it - you run it: Mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität begleitest Du neue Regionen von der Inbetriebnahme bis in den stabilen Betrieb - gemeinsam mit unseren Datacenter Engineers vor Ort.

•
Architektur & Wissen: Du prägst Architektur-, Design- und Integrationsentscheidungen, etablierst Standards und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv im Team - Runbooks, Troubleshooting-Guides, Pairing.

Das bringst du mit:

•
OpenStack in Produktion: Du hast OpenStack-Umgebungen produktiv betrieben, erweitert und durch Upgrades gebracht. Begriffe wie Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone, Placement, Octavia oder Ironic sind für Dich Alltag, nicht Theorie - und Du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung

Brief info about Vinted

Information about the position 

The AML Compliance Manager will support the day-to-day execution of the AML/CFT compliance framework. This is a hands-on role requiring 3 - 4 years of AML compliance experience, focused on customer due diligence, PEP and high-risk customer approvals, first-line escalations, ongoing monitoring, and preparation of AML governance materials for senior management.

In this position, you’ll 

• Review customer onboarding and periodic review files prepared by the first line of defense.

• Assess KYC completeness, customer risk ratings, beneficial ownership, ownership structures, business rationale, and expected activity.

• Perform Enhanced Due Diligence on higher-risk customers, including review of source of funds, source of wealth, geographic risk, adverse media, and transaction rationale.

• Review and approve, or recommend approval of, higher-risk customers in line with internal procedures.

• Assess PEP cases and prepare PEP approval recommendations for Compliance or senior management.

• Review AML/CFT escalations from the first line and provide clear compliance advice.

• Challenge incomplete or insufficient first-line analysis and request additional information where needed.

• Review sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening alerts and escalate material issues.

• Review SAR related escalations and SAR drafts to be filed to local FIU.

• Support ongoing monitoring, trigger-event reviews, and periodic KYC refreshes.

• Identify AML/CFT red flags and escalate potential suspicious activity in accordance with internal procedures.

• Prepare AML governance material, including customer approval memos, escalation summaries, risk assessments, and management reporting.

• Maintain logs of approvals, escalations, exceptions, and pending actions.

• Support updates to AML/CFT procedures, checklists, controls, and internal guidance.

• Assist with audit, regulatory, and internal compliance requests when required.

About you 

• 3-4 years’ experience in AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence, or financial crime compliance.

• Good understanding of Luxembourg and EU AML/CFT requirements.

• Practical experience reviewing customer onboarding files, KYC documentation, beneficial ownership, risk ratings, source of funds and source of wealth.

• Experience assessing higher-risk customers, PEPs, complex structures, adverse media, and sanctions-related alerts.

• Experience with SAR drafting and filing to local FIU.

• Ability to review and challenge first-line-of-defense escalations.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LL.B., LL.M., or MLaw)

• 5+ years of experience in commercial contract negotiation, legal governance, or legal management

• Proven expertise in data protection regulations (Swiss FADP/DSG and EU GDPR) to fulfill DPO role

• Ability to manage high-impact priorities effectively

• Strong command of English (written and spoken) with precise legal drafting capability

• Strong attention to detail and sound business judgment

• Qualified to practice law (Bar Admission in Switzerland or another recognized jurisdiction)

• Background in high-growth tech sectors

Ververica is the original creator of Apache Flink® and remains a core contributor to it. Flink is the leading open-source engine for stream and batch processing. It runs mission-critical workloads at Netflix, Alibaba, Amazon and Uber, as well as at banks, telcos and global enterprises.

We build Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform, an enterprise-grade platform for real-time data on top of Flink. Backed by one of the world's largest tech companies, we combine open-source innovation with long-term stability.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
We are hiring a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to be the technical lead for our customers across North and South America. You will be their trusted advisor and hands-on partner, from first deployment through long-term production operations.

You will work with platform owners, data engineers and architects to design, run and scale their stream processing on Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform. Because you work in their time zone, you will be the person they reach first when something matters, during the sales process and after it.

• 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as TAM, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect or Support Engineer.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience. Our product runs on Kubernetes, so this is essential.

• Experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

• Ability to read and reason about Java code, working knowledge of Java 11+ and a basic understanding of the JVM.

• Working knowledge of SQL, including querying streaming data.

• Experience with distributed data processing or streaming systems such as Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark or Redpanda.

• Proven ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under time pressure.

• Ability to manage several accounts and projects at once, set priorities and meet deadlines.

• Clear written and spoken English. You are comfortable with both engineers and executives.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience running Apache Flink in production, or contributions to open-source data infrastructure projects.

• Working knowledge of Python, useful for customers on PyFlink.

• Experience with observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog or Dynatrace.

• Familiarity with DevOps workflows and CI/CD tooling in cloud-native environments.

• Spanish or Portuguese, for customers in Latin America.

LOCATION AND WORKING HOURS

This is a remote role for someone based between UTC-4 and UTC-7. That covers US and Canadian Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, plus Latin American countries in the same range.

• Your core hours follow your customers' business day in the Americas.

• A few early mornings each week overlap with our EMEA team for handovers and escalations.

• Occasional travel to customer sites and events, within North and South America.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the technical relationship with a portfolio of enterprise customers in the Americas, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

• Guide customers in designing and optimizing their stream processing architecture on Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform.

• Advise on Flink job design, deployment models (on-premises Kubernetes, public cloud, managed service, Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC)) and monitoring strategy.

• Troubleshoot and tune pipelines, connectors and clusters, and identify weak spots in customer architectures before they cause incidents.

• Lead incident triage and root cause analysis for your accounts, and build operational playbooks that help customers run Flink at scale.

• Support migrations from legacy or batch-based systems to real-time processing.

• Support pre-sales with technical discovery, proofs of concept and architecture reviews alongside the Sales team.

• Run regular check-ins and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)

title: Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland
description:
Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.
The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.
What you will work on
The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.
What you bring
Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.
Useful but not essential:
A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

You'll be responsible for building and maintaining the systems that power everything at Column - from our payments stack to developer APIs to core platform services. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of distributed systems, financial infrastructure, and clean API design. Expect to own core parts of our backend and shape the technical foundation of a company moving billions of dollars per day.

This position will be based in our San Francisco office in the Presidio, and reports directly to William, the CEO.

Read more about Life @ Column and our hiring process here https://www.notion.so/Hiring-at-Column-b8d9b2628317491989d4713091b6bb68?pvs=21. 🚀

What you'll do:

- Build and maintain the backend systems powering Column's core banking platform - payments processing, transaction logic, and real-time ledgering

- Own direct integrations with the Federal Reserve and real-time payment networks, ensuring correctness and reliability at every layer

- Design and implement APIs, services, and data pipelines that both internal teams and external developers depend on

- Drive improvements to system resiliency, scalability, and observability across our distributed architecture

- Lead cross-cutting platform initiatives like authentication/authorization, event streaming, and change data capture

- Write code that runs close to the money: optimize for correctness, performance, and fault tolerance in a regulated environment

- Uphold the highest standards for system safety in a mission-critical, compliance-sensitive context

- 💳 FSA and HSA account options to enable use of pre-tax money for medical and dependent care expenses

- 📈 401k plan, including self-directed brokerage options

- 🌴 Flexible time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge

MANAGER, REVENUE OPERATIONS, CN

title: Energy Associate
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

ROLE SCOPE

- Diligence prospective sites across both paths to power, grid interconnection and behind-the-meter generation, and turn each one into a go or no-go recommendation in days rather than weeks.

- Build and own the delivered cost of power model across candidate sites and both paths, from tariffs and network upgrade exposure on the grid side to gas basis, transport, heat rate, and availability behind the meter.

- Be the single source of truth on where every site stands, queue position and study milestones on the grid side, contracted fuel and generation position behind the meter, and what has to happen next on each.

- Run the diligence file on every live site, tariff filings and interconnection studies, pipeline and interconnect agreements, air permits, offtake term sheets, and generation specifications, kept clean enough to walk a counterparty or a lender through cold.

- Support the Leads through live negotiations with term sheet comparisons, sensitivity runs, counterparty and credit screens, and the one number that decides the question, delivered before the next call rather than after it.

- Track the markets and the policy that set the rules we build under, ISO large load processes, rate cases and tariff changes, and gas fundamentals in the basins we are buying into.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

- You've built a model that someone traded, invested, or committed capital off, and you can defend every assumption in it under pressure.

- You've read a contract, tariff, or study report closely and pulled out the two or three terms that actually change the economics, rather than summarising the whole thing.

- You turn a disordered data room into a one page recommendation that names the thing the decision actually turns on.

- You've caught a material error in someone else's work before it reached a decision maker, and you raised it rather than working around it.

- You've been dropped into a market or an asset class you did not know and been useful inside a few weeks, and you can point to how you got up to speed.

- You write up what you found the same day you found it, so a site file never depends on what is in your head.

- Bonus: Commodities trad

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Agentic Engineering

We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to join our new Agentic Engineering team and own program delivery for the platform that lets Lightspeed's Product & Technology teams work effectively with AI agents across the full product development lifecycle.

You will help turn a fast-moving technology into secure, reliable, reusable capabilities, and make sure the right things ship, in the right order, with the right guardrails. You’ll also own AI readiness across Product & Technology: finding the gaps in skills, tooling, and configuration that stop teams from getting value from AI, and closing them.

This is a founding role on a new team: you'll build the operating cadence, the intake model, and the delivery mechanisms as the platform takes shape.

This role sits under P&T Operations, reporting to the Director of Technical Program Management, you will partner closely with Senior Director, Agentic Engineering, their team and a Staff TPM, PDLC.

What you’ll be doing:

Drive platform delivery

- Partner with the Agentic Engineering team on the roadmap, milestones, and dependency plan for the agentic platform: reusable agents, workflow orchestration, context and knowledge access, tool integrations, evaluation, observability, and governance, including the MCP servers and integrations teams need to do their work.

- Run the operating cadence for the team (planning, reviews, decision logs, risk and exception tracking, retros) and keep it light.

- Make trade-offs visible early: scope, capacity, cost, and risk, including model and compute cost.

Run intake and launches with early adopters

- Build the intake and prioritization model for use cases coming from Retail, Hospitality, Payments, and platform teams.

- Include gaps surfaced from the field (tooling, settings, access, integrations) in the same intake and prioritization model.

- Plan and launch first use cases with early teams, then package proven patterns so others can adopt them without rebuilding.

Embed evaluation and governance by design

title: GRC Analyst
locationText: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India
description:
Overview:

Guidepoint's Engineering team thrives on delivering innovative technology solutions that accelerate revenue growth, reduce costs, and increase efficiency and productivity. As Guidepoint achieves its mission of making individuals, businesses, and the world smarter through personalized knowledge-sharing solutions, the engineering team is taking on challenges to create new products and improve existing platforms to optimize the seamless delivery of our services.

This can be a hybrid position out of one of our offices in India (Mumbai, Pune) or remote.

What You’ll Do:

Third-party risk and vendor management

• Run vendor risk assessment process: risk-tier new suppliers by data access, criticality and integration with our systems.

• Issue, chase and review security questionnaires (e.g. SIG Lite), and assess vendors' SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001 certificates.

• Review SOC 2 reports for exceptions and scope gaps.

• Help maintain the vendor inventory and risk register, including risk ratings and review cycles.

• Schedule and complete periodic reassessments based on vendor tier, and track remediation actions to closure.

SOC 2 support

• Collect, organise and quality-check audit evidence across the control set (access reviews, change management, onboarding/offboarding, backups, vulnerability management).

• Coordinate evidence requests with control owners and keep the audit timeline on track.

• Help run internal control testing ahead of the audit window and log findings and exceptions.

• Act as a point of contact for external auditors during fieldwork, under the guidance of the GRC lead.

• Help the team with client and prospect due diligence. Manage client trust portal requests.

ISO 27001 alignment

• Help review and maintain ISMS documentation and security policies.

• Contribute to the information security risk assessment and treatment plan.

General GRC

• Keep policies on a review cycle and track staff acknowledgement.

• Help with regular reporting and metrics on risk, control health and audit readiness.

Required Technical Qualifications:

• 2-3 years in GRC, information security, IT audit, risk or a related compliance role.

• Working knowledge of at least one security framework, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or NIST CSF.

• Understanding of core security concepts: access control, change management, encryption, vulnerability management, incident response.

• Comfortable with spreadsheets and ticketing or workflow tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with a compliance automation platform (e.g. Vanta, Drata, Secureframe) or a TPRM tool (e.g. OneTrust, Whistic, SecurityScorecard).

• Experience reading SOC 2 Type II reports or completing vendor security questionnaires.

• Exposure to an external audit or certification process.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and SaaS identity tools (e.g. Okta, Entra ID).

• Knowledge of GDPR or other privacy regulations.

• A relevant certification or one in progress: e.g. ISO 27001 Foundation or Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC.

• Secure use of AI tools to automate GRC functions

Competencies:

• Strong organisation and follow-through: you can manage many open requests at once and keep a clean audit trail.

• Clear written communication, and the confidence to chase stakeholders and vendors politely but persistently.

• Good attention to detail when reviewing documents and evidence.

• Competitive compensation  

• Employee medical coverage  

• Central office location  

• Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions  

• Casual work environment

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

- Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

- Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

- Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

- Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

- Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

- Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

- Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

- Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

- An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

- A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

- A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

- A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

- Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

- Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

BENEFITS

- 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

- Share Incentive Plan 📈

- Workplace Pension 💰

- Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

- Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

- Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

- £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

- £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

- 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Manchester and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.
